title: Term Schedule of the PBM Services Agreement
content:
Schedule of contract term figures for the PBM Services Agreement, by pricing arrangement.

**Initial term** — months, counted from go-live. **Renewal term** — months of each automatic renewal after the initial term. **Termination notice** — calendar days of written notice required to terminate without cause. **Early termination fee** — USD per enrolled employee for each month remaining in the initial term, payable when the agreement is terminated without cause before the initial term ends.

| Pricing arrangement | Initial term (months from go-live) | Renewal term (months) | Termination notice without cause (calendar days) | Early termination fee (USD per enrolled employee per remaining month) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Traditional Pricing | 36 | 12 | 180 | 2.00 |
| Northbridge Pass-Through Pricing | 36 | 12 | 120 | 1.50 |
| Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus | 36 | 12 | 90 | 0.00 |
| Northbridge Rebate Guarantee Plus | 36 | 12 | 90 | 1.00 |
| Northbridge Enterprise Value | 48 | 12 | 90 | 1.25 |
| Northbridge Coalition Purchasing | 36 | 12 | 90 | 0.00 |

Footnotes to the schedule:

1. Northbridge Enterprise Value is the only arrangement with a 48-month initial term; the other five run 36 months.
2. Every arrangement renews for 12 months at a time.
3. Northbridge Transparent Cost-Plus and Northbridge Coalition Purchasing carry an early termination fee of 0.00, so a termination without cause inside their initial term costs no fee under this schedule.
4. Hypothetical reading of the fee figure: under an arrangement whose fee is 1.00, a sponsor with (hypothetically) 400 enrolled employees and (hypothetically) 10 months left in the initial term faces a fee of 1.00 multiplied by 400 employees multiplied by 10 months, that is 4000.00 USD.
